description: Hook points fired by aos-eca-turn (the eca body), and before_compact / after_compact fired by the eca-claude template's compact_hook from Claude Code's own compaction hooks; tool hooks are in ../mcp/hooks.json, the loop points in ../hook/loop_hooks.json. The agent family's rules (aos.agentlib.hooks, in code; this file only tells): exit 10 blocks a point with block true; on a point with output, exit 0 and a JSON object on stdout replace those keys; condition names the field a hookeds entry's condition is compared with (only for these tool names / error codes); a failing hook stops a point with block true and is one warning elsewhere.

before_queue.description: turn: every good letter before it is handed to the CLI, slash letters too; also letters that arrive while waiting for the answer

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

content.description: the text that will be handed over

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

before_queue.if_blocked: the letter is closed and dropped; mailbox_warning.txt says which hook dropped it

after_queue.description: the letter was handed to the CLI, joined history and was closed; a failing hook is reported only after the answer is in history

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

content.description: the text that was handed over

brain_failed.description: turn: the CLI failed after the letters were handed over

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

code.description: claude only: the same error code

retry.description: claude only: true when the letters are sent again after a cooldown

attempt.description: claude only: failures in a row

dropped.description: claude only: how many letters were dropped

wait_s.description: claude only, when retry is true: seconds of cooldown

status.description: claude only, when known: the HTTP status

cause.description: claude only, when known: the CLI's own failure cause

brain_failed.subject: code

tool_added.description: turn: before each handoff to the CLI, a tool name appeared in this agent's tool registry (the first look only remembers the names)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

tool_added.subject: tool

on_clock.description: start of every turn (also turns in a cooldown or that give way): the hook's clock moved on by its own every_cycles / every_ms

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

first.description: true right after a start, a wake or a clock change

last_cycle.description: cycle of the last run, or null

config.description: the entry's config, when it has one

before_compact.description: claude kind only, from the definition's compact_hook, which the eca-claude template wires as Claude Code's own PreCompact hook (cli.json settings): Claude Code is about to compact the conversation, for a /compact or on its own; pi and codex do not fire it (compact_hook fires it through aos-hook fire and reads the results itself: the first hook that exits 10 blocks; each JSON object on stdout of a hook that exits 0 sets instructions / restore, in name order; every hook gets the same event; a failing hook is a warning)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

trigger.description: manual (a /compact) or auto (Claude Code compacts on its own)

asked.description: the words after /compact, or an empty string

instructions.description: the summary instructions compact_hook gives Claude Code on top of asked (the template's list of what to keep); a hook may change them, an empty string gives none

restore.description: null; a hook may set text that compact_hook adds to the compacted conversation (through Claude Code's SessionStart compact hook, after the handoff notes), for this compaction only

output.description: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout: these keys replace the event's

before_compact.if_blocked: compact_hook exits 2 and Claude Code does not compact; for a /compact the CLI says the hook's name and stdout, an automatic compaction is skipped (or the request that needed the room fails); the summary and history stay as they were

after_compact.description: claude kind only, from compact_hook as Claude Code's own PostCompact hook: the conversation was compacted; it only tells (nothing can be changed any more; text to add after the compaction is before_compact's restore, since Claude Code runs its SessionStart compact hook before PostCompact) (compact_hook fires it through aos-hook fire and ignores the results)

stack.description: the agent's stack (the handler's own AOS_STACK is STACK/hookeds/NAME/)

trigger.description: manual or auto, as for before_compact

summary.description: the summary Claude Code wrote, or null
